versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated platform execution requirements from "python3" to "python".
- Switched to pulling TOP 20 hot searches per platform (Weibo, Douyin, Baidu) with concurrent fetching for improved speed.
- Now supports parameterless concurrent fetch for all platforms or single platform via --platform option.
- Standardized and documented JSON output schema including platform status and fetch performance meta.
- Defined a strict, human-friendly markdown output template for rendering results after JSON output, improving readability and cross-platform topic summarization.
更新：增加输出分析说明，支持对话题进行总结分析归类
首次发布：获取微博、抖音、百度热搜排行榜
